description: Defines the ProgramTable class and related components for managing MPEG program data and observers within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Manages MPEG program tables, observers, and NIT PIDs, providing registration, unregistration, and lookup functionalities.

classes.name: ProgramTable::Observer
classes.description: Inner class that observes MPEG sections and interacts with the ProgramTable.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer callback for a specific keyId.

methods.name: Program
methods.description: Checks if a program has been updated and retrieves its data.

methods.name: NITPid
methods.description: Retrieves the NIT PID for a given keyId.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Generates a unique key from keyId and programId.

methods.name: AddProgram
methods.description: Adds or updates a program in the internal map.
